content: Taran kut thung hoi rungngang nahanlah ratoumnae
Kathutkung: Devit, Devit teh Benjamin tami Kush e lawk kecu dawk BAWIPA hmalah a sak e la

content.text: Oe BAWIPA, ka Cathut, nang teh na kâuep.
Na ka pacekpahlek e pueng koehoi na rungngang nateh na hlout sak haw.
Hoehpawiteh, sendek patetlah na kei vaiteh,
rungngangkung ao hoehnahlan vah, na paset awh han doeh.
Oe BAWIPA ka Cathut, kai ni hottelah ka sak vaiteh,
ka kut dawk payonnae kaawm nakunghai,
Kai koe duem kaawm e hah thoenae hoi ka patho teh,
ka tarannaw hah a khuekhaw awm laipalah ka coungroe pawiteh,
taran ni na pâlei naseh, na phat naseh.
Kahringnae hah talai dawk repcoungroe awh naseh.
Minhmai barinae hah vaiphu dawk tat awh naseh. Selah.
Oe BAWIPA, lungkhuek laihoi thaw haw,
ka tarannaw e lungkhueknae hah ngang haw.
Kâ na poe tangcoung patetlah kai han lawkceng hanlah thaw haw.
Miphunnaw kamkhueng awh vaiteh,
nang hah na kalup awh han.
Ahnimouh hanlah arasangnae koe ban haw.
BAWIPA ni lawk a ceng han.
Oe BAWIPA, ka lannae hoi ka thung kaawm e yuemkamcu lah
ka o e patetlah lawk na ceng haw.
Oe tamikathoutnaw,
thoenae teh poutsak lah awm lawiseh.
Hatei, lannae teh caksak lah awm seh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, ka lan e Cathut ni lungthin hoi
pouknae hah ouk a tanouk.
Lungthin kalannaw rungngangkung Cathut teh
kai kânguenae lah ao.
Cathut teh kalan e lawkcengkung lah ao teh,
Cathut teh tamikathoutnaw koe hnintangkuem a lungkhuek.
Pankângai hoehpawiteh, a tahloi hah kata vaiteh,
licung hah sawn vaiteh, coungkacoe lah ao han.
Duenae senehmaica hai ahni hanlah a rakueng teh,
hmai kang thai e samtang hah a sak awh.
Tamikathout ni yonnae hah a khe.
Runae hah a vawn teh laithoe ouk a khe.
Tangkom kadungpoung lah a tai teh,
a tai e tangkom dawk ama letlang a bo.
A sak e runae hah amae lû van bout ban vaiteh,
a tâcosak e thoenae teh amae lû van bout a pha han.
BAWIPA teh a lan e patetlah ka pholen han.
Lathueng Poung BAWIPA min pholen hoi la ka sak han.
